_comment: The template a deployment stack deploys, and the only part of this week that
Deployment stacks have no Terraform resource. Checked 2026-09-20 against the
azurerm provider's own documentation tree: there are *_template_deployment
resources, and nothing for Microsoft.Resources/deploymentStacks. Microsoft's
guidance says as much - 'To create and update a deployment stack, use the
Azure CLI, Azure PowerShell, or the Azure portal with Bicep files.'
SUBSCRIPTION-scoped, because a stack at management group scope deploys INTO a
subscription. That is also why it creates its own resource group: the stack
must own everything it protects, and a resource group created by Terraform
would have two owners and an ambiguous teardown.
ARM JSON rather than Bicep deliberately - it needs no extra toolchain, and it
is what Bicep compiles to before the stack ever sees it.
metadata._armNote: ARM rejects a top-level '//' member with InvalidRequestContent: "Could not find member '//' on object of type 'Template'". Commentary belongs in metadata, which is a schema member.

metadata.description: Globally unique. Passed in rather than derived, so the same name is used by the deploy and by the checks that try to delete it.
